about: *The titles included in this bundle cannot be purchased separately. The bundle is offered at the same price, and the Classic version is included. Dodge the barrage, defeat the enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist Incident. Touhou Koumakyou, from the Touhou Project series by Team Shanghai Alice, makes its debut. Take control of Reimu the shrine maiden or Marisa the magician as you set out to resolve an incident threatening Gensokyo. The New Classic version features upgraded high-resolution visuals, with every BGM track newly arranged by ZUN. It also introduces a new mode where you can take on the game with unlimited lives. You can also play the Classic version, which perfectly preserves the original 2002 gameplay. *All text in the Classic version is in Japanese. Supported languages: Text languages: Japanese / English / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / Korean / French / German / Spanish / Russian / Portuguese (Brazil) / Italian
